about: The machine's Oxy session in an application the session launched (docs/adr/0020-oxy-account-login.mdx, decision 6; sample/oxyos/session-host.js): the runtime's framework registered OxyOS as the Oxy SDK's session host before the application's bundle ran (sample/AccountProbe.tsx reads it where the SDK does), its snapshot the accounts' service's (played, regress.py's `account`: the service knows the application by its launch). Asked for a token, the application gets one minted for its own entry, never another's (the probe shows whom it names, never the token); the service's snapshot changing (the account renamed elsewhere) reaches it without its asking.

steps.name: the platform's session, shown as the SDK reads it
a token for this application's entry, asked at boot
the account renamed elsewhere: the service's new snapshot reaches the application
